summary.zh: 按 CEFR 水平推荐瑞典语学习路径与听力素材
summary.en: Swedish study path and listening material by CEFR level

description.zh: 根据当前的 CEFR 等级和学习目标安排瑞典语学习路径，并挑选合适的 YouTube 短片与播客，包括面向初学者的慢速新闻节目。适合准备 SFI 课程、自学或想找听得懂的真实语料时使用。推荐节目均为公开内容，播放时需要联网。
description.en: Builds a Swedish study path for your CEFR level and picks YouTube clips and podcasts, including slow-news shows for beginners. Good for SFI or self-study. Playback needs internet.
